concerns.text: Phase 4.5 (Physical Parameterization) introduces tasks T058-T063 implementing bond angles, inter-atomic distances, and crystallinity scores. These features are explicitly excluded by spec.md Constraints ('Only topological features are included') and are not covered by any FR/SC in spec.md. The tasks implement unapproved scope creep without a corresponding requirement in the spec.

Task T060 updates the `MolecularGraph` entity to include physical fields (`bond_angles`, `crystallinity_score`). The spec.md Data Model defines `MolecularGraph` with only `smiles`, `nodes`, `edges`, and `features`. There is no spec requirement to expand this entity schema with physical parameters, creating orphan implementation work.

Task T061 updates `code/models/gat.py` to accept physical feature channels. Spec.md FR-002 and FR-003 define feature extraction and model architecture strictly for 'topological features'. There is no FR/SC requiring the model to ingest physical descriptors (bond angles, etc.), making this task unlinked to the spec.

Task T043 (Integrated Gradients) targets 'Physical features (bond angles, bond lengths, crystallinity)'. Spec.md FR-006 requires attribution analysis only for 'topological features'. The task implements analysis for features not required by the spec.

Task T058 references '[FR-002-REV]' in its tag. Spec.md contains no such requirement ID; FR-002 is strictly about topological features. This tag references a non-existent requirement, indicating a stale or hallucinated spec reference.
